description: Which header names carry a credential. The gateway's request log and trace export (agentcc-gateway/internal/credentials: credentials_test.go; the logging and otel plugins' tests) and the backend's request-log ingestion and stored-row scrub (futureagi/agentcc/services/credential_headers.py: futureagi/agentcc/tests/test_request_log_credential_headers.py) never keep the value of a header named under credential, and keep every header named under plain as it was sent. Both tests read this file, so the two cannot drift apart unnoticed. Names match without regard to case, and an underscore counts as a hyphen. The first group under credential is the named list (every header the gateway reads its key from, every header a provider or guardrail adapter sends a key in, and common credential headers); the rest are caught because their name reads as a credential: it holds a credential word, it holds token in any word (not tokens, not a tokenizer, and not token followed by count, budget, limit, usage, used, remaining, total, max or min, which name a count of tokens), its last word is auth, its last word is key after a word that does not name a lookup key (cache, idempotency and the like), or it starts with X-Portkey-.
